BDI.csv.name: Baltic Dry Index
BDI.csv.source: TradingView chart widget (embedded on tradingeconomics.com), WebSocket capture
BDI.csv.method: scripts/parse_bdi.py over MessageEvent-hook capture at interval=1D
BDI.csv.notes: Replaces the earlier monthly capture (in git history). Range buttons override interval on this widget: 5Y serves weekly, ALL serves monthly. A spurious 1969-12-31 point was dropped.

BCI.csv.name: Baltic Capesize Index
BCI.csv.source: investing.com historical-data CSV export (2012-07-05 to 2025-03-31) merged with a Google Visualization chart payload carrying daily BACI values (2024-10-16 to 2026-09-17)
BCI.csv.method: two sources merged on date; 103 overlapping days agree exactly, zero disagreements
BCI.csv.notes: Single published fix per day, so a lone Price column is equivalent to the four identical OHLC columns. Goes NEGATIVE on 44 days between 2020-01-31 and 2020-05-14, low -372 on 2020-03-09. Real: the Capesize timecharter average went below zero. Percentage returns undefined across the 4 sign crossings; use point changes. All 14 gaps over 7 days are Baltic year-end publication breaks.

BDTI.csv.name: Baltic Dirty Tanker Index
BDTI.csv.source: barchart.com (BDTI.BI), original manual pull plus two patch exports
BDTI.csv.method: merged on date across three pulls. The export caps at 640 rows anchored on the END date, so the 2011 hole was closed by setting the end date to mid-2011 rather than adjusting the start. Patch 1 (2011-05-11..2013-11-26) agreed on 604 overlapping days; patch 2 (2008-10-15..2011-05-12) agreed on 557. Zero disagreements across either overlap.
BDTI.csv.notes: COMPLETE. No gap over 12 days anywhere in the series; all 24 long gaps are Baltic year-end publication breaks. Single published fix per day, so Date,Close only. The IsComplete flag specified in Phase 2 is no longer needed for 2011.
